profile.summary: Experienced Embedded Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the automotive industry. Skilled in  Embedded Software, Requirements Analysis, System Integration, C, C++, CAN and Battery Management Systems. Strong engineering professional with a Master's Degree focused in Electrical and Electronics Engineering from Instituto Tecnologico de Morelia with especiality on High Voltage Power Electronics.
